articles.title_en: Fire at power plant in Russia’s Far East disrupts heating to nearby communities
articles.lead_en: A fire broke out September 22 at the Neryungri Power Plant in Yakutia, damaging a transformer substation for power unit No. 1 and a turbine in the machine room.

articles.title_en: Russia’s State Duma election delivered record turnout and a landslide for United Russia. Kremlin insiders say the results were achieved ‘through very dirty means.’
articles.lead_en: With 93% of precinct returns processed, United Russia, the country’s ruling party, had won about 58% of the vote in the election to the State Duma. Russia’s Communist Party (KPRF) placed second with about 14%, according to the Central Election Commission.
